bhagavad_gita.translation: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action.
bhagavad_gita.context: Focus on doing your work with full dedication. Don't worry about the results. When you let go of outcome anxiety, you perform better and feel peaceful.
bhagavad_gita.application: When stressed about results, remember: your job is to do your best work, not to control outcomes.

bhagavad_gita.translation: Perform your duty equipoised, O Arjuna, abandoning all attachment to success or failure.
bhagavad_gita.context: Stay balanced in success and failure. This mental equilibrium is called yoga.
bhagavad_gita.application: Whether your project succeeds or fails, maintain inner peace. Your worth isn't defined by outcomes.

quran.context: Allah promises that difficulty is always followed by relief. Every hardship has a solution.
quran.application: When stressed, remember this too shall pass. Ease is coming after your current difficulty.

quran.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
quran.translation: And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them.
quran.context: Trust in God's plan. He will provide solutions when you maintain faith and patience.
quran.application: Have faith. Solutions exist even when you can't see them yet.

bible.verse: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
bible.context: Jesus invites those carrying heavy burdens to find rest in faith.
bible.application: When overwhelmed, take a moment to pray or meditate. Release your burdens.

bible.verse: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
bible.context: God cares about your worries. You don't have to carry them alone.
bible.application: Write down your worries, then consciously let them go. Trust in a higher power.

bible.verse: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
bible.context: Replace anxiety with gratitude and prayer.
bible.application: List 3 things you're grateful for right now. Gratitude reduces anxiety.

guru_granth_sahib.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ
guru_granth_sahib.translation: God is everything, God is everything. There is nothing without God.
guru_granth_sahib.context: When you realize the divine presence in everything, stress dissolves.
guru_granth_sahib.application: See challenges as part of a bigger divine plan. Everything has purpose.

guru_granth_sahib.translation: One in whose mind the Lord abides is at peace.
guru_granth_sahib.context: True peace comes from inner connection with the divine, not external circumstances.
guru_granth_sahib.application: Take 5 minutes to sit quietly and connect with your inner self.

bhagavad_gita.translation: From anger comes delusion; from delusion, loss of memory; from loss of memory, destruction of discrimination; from destruction of discrimination, one perishes.
bhagavad_gita.context: Anger clouds judgment and leads to poor decisions. It destroys wisdom.
bhagavad_gita.application: Before reacting in anger, pause. Take 3 deep breaths. Then respond with clarity.

quran.translation: Those who control their anger and pardon others.
quran.context: Controlling anger and forgiving others are qualities of the righteous.
quran.application: When angry with someone, try to understand their perspective. Forgiveness frees you.

bible.verse: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
bible.context: Soft responses de-escalate conflicts; harsh words inflame them.
bible.application: In conflict, speak calmly and kindly. Your tone can change everything.

bible.verse: In your anger do not sin: Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry.
bible.context: It's okay to feel angry, but resolve conflicts quickly before they fester.
bible.application: Address conflicts today. Don't let resentment build overnight.

guru_granth_sahib.context: Anger harms you more than others. Release it for your own peace.
guru_granth_sahib.application: Ask yourself: Will this matter in 5 years? Most conflicts won't.

bhagavad_gita.translation: One must elevate oneself by one's own mind, not degrade oneself.
bhagavad_gita.context: You are your own friend or enemy. Your mind can lift you up or bring you down.
bhagavad_gita.application: Start small. One task today. Build momentum gradually.

quran.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
quran.translation: Truly with hardship comes ease, truly with hardship comes ease.
quran.context: Repeated twice for emphasis - relief always follows difficulty.
quran.application: This low phase is temporary. Better days are ahead.

bible.verse: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
bible.context: Divine strength is available when you feel weak.
bible.application: You're stronger than you think. Take one step forward today.

bible.verse: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
bible.context: Persistence pays off. Keep going even when you're tired.
bible.application: Your efforts will pay off. Don't quit right before the breakthrough.

guru_granth_sahib.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤਾ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਈਐ
guru_granth_sahib.translation: Through sincere devotion and action, greatness is achieved.
guru_granth_sahib.context: Consistent effort, done with faith, leads to success.
guru_granth_sahib.application: Show up every day. Small consistent actions beat big sporadic efforts.

bhagavad_gita.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत
bhagavad_gita.translation: Whenever there is decline of righteousness and rise of unrighteousness, I manifest myself.
bhagavad_gita.context: Divine help arrives when needed most. You're never alone in dark times.
bhagavad_gita.application: Have faith that help will come when you need it most.

quran.translation: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.
quran.context: Even in fear, remember divine presence protects you.
quran.application: You're not alone. A higher power walks with you.

bible.verse: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.
bible.context: Fear doesn't come from God. You have power, love, and clarity within you.
bible.application: Replace fear thoughts with empowering ones. You have inner strength.

guru_granth_sahib.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਦੇਤ ਨਹਿ ਨਹਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਨਤ ਆਨ
guru_granth_sahib.translation: One who does not frighten anyone, and who is not afraid of anyone else.
guru_granth_sahib.context: Living fearlessly and causing no harm brings inner peace.
guru_granth_sahib.application: Act with courage and kindness. Fear less, love more.
